items.statement: The submitted 10f calculation validates the reported optimized stationary point as a minimum using vibrational evidence and identifies the system as neutral singlet.
items.expected: A documented frequency/curvature result with no imaginary frequencies (or an explicitly reported bounded failure), plus charge 0 and multiplicity 1.

items.statement: Derived descriptors are calculated consistently from the submitted HOMO and LUMO values with explicit units and formulas.
items.expected: The report states the orbital sign convention and shows ΔE, η and ω formulas or equivalent algebra, with internally consistent values.

items.statement: The paper reports a small frontier-orbital gap for 10f.
items.expected: HOMO −5.63 eV, LUMO −2.34 eV and gap 3.29 eV, subject to method-aware comparison.

items.statement: The paper reports low hardness and high electrophilicity for 10f.
items.expected: Chemical hardness 1.64 eV and electrophilicity 4.82 eV, subject to method-aware comparison.
